All ten complete outcome rows are compared with native serialized command replays.
limitations: System targets covered. Sectors, wider starfighter variants and broad targeting/loss-prevention interactions remain required before complete card admission.

Native-only checks additionally cover Sense, ordered crew/weapon loss, replacing/canceling draws, corruption, repeated Interrupts, canceled battle and service/browser recovery; these are not separate GEMP outcome claims.
